metrics.name: prop_chose_risky
metrics.description: Proportion of trials where the agent chose the risky option. Random would be 0.50; risk-averse humans typically pick risky <0.5 of the time when expected values are matched.

metrics.name: prop_chose_higher_ev
metrics.description: On trials where one option has a clearly higher expected value, proportion of trials where the agent picked the higher-EV option. Random ~0.50; humans typically 0.70-0.80.

metrics.name: mean_correct_rt
metrics.description: Mean RT on EV-correct trials (ms). Ciranka et al. report median RT around 2200ms for adolescent samples in this paradigm.
